filter.description:
{@link Filter} for fetching {@link InventorySeries}s to refresh stats.
Only the parts satisfying the filter condition will have the latest stats.

limit.description:
Indicates the maximum number of parts to fetch for refreshing the stats.
Set to -1 by default, to fetch all the parts from {@link InventorySeries}

doNotCalculateWorkOrderStats.description: If true, skip calculation of Work Order Stats

doNotCalculatePurchaseOrderStats.description: If true, skip calculation of Purchase Order Stats

doNotCalculateInventoryStats.description: If true, skip calculation of Inventory Stats

title: This type allows us to specify fetch parameters for retrieving parts, from {@link InventorySeries}, whose stats will be refreshed.
name: InventorySeriesFetchSpec
